items.title: Character Overload
items.task: Which fictional character can you spot most often?
items.followUp: Why can an imaginary character become valuable in the real world?

moreInfo.title: Why a drawing can cost money
moreInfo.text: A character can be licensed. Shops pay to print it on bags, games and snacks. Fans keep the picture valuable by wanting it.

items.title: The ¥1,000 Challenge
items.task: Find the strangest thing you would genuinely buy for ¥1,000 or less.
items.rewardIdea: Family votes. Winner may buy it. Not a payment in the app.
